description: A React component for creating and editing tags within the Superset frontend, including resource selection and API interactions.

classes.name: TaggableResourceOption
classes.description: Option type for resources that can be tagged, with label, value, and key.

classes.name: TaggableResources
classes.description: Enumeration of resource types that can be tagged: chart, dashboard, saved query.

classes.name: TagModalProps
classes.description: Props interface for the TagModal component, including callbacks and optional edit tag.

classes.name: TagModal
classes.description: React functional component for creating/editing tags with resource selection.

methods.name: clearTagForm
methods.description: Resets all form fields and resource selections.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches resource data from API with search and pagination.

methods.name: loadCharts
methods.description: Loads chart options based on search criteria.

methods.name: loadDashboards
methods.description: Loads dashboard options based on search criteria.

methods.name: loadQueries
methods.description: Loads saved query options based on search criteria.

methods.name: handleOptionChange
methods.description: Updates resource selection state based on user input.

methods.name: handleTagNameChange
methods.description: Updates tag name state on input change.

methods.name: handleDescriptionChange
methods.description: Updates description state on input change.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the tag via API, either creating or updating, then refreshes data and resets form.
